nodes.contentSummary: Initialized crystal 'artifact-ontology-exploration' with goal: Reason and design artifact & world state abstraction in Context Crystal DAG and registry

Consensus reached on Artifact & World-State Ontology: Substrate (Virtual, Physical), Role (Target, Instrument, Precondition), Optional URI with standard RFCs, PhysicalLocation with civic/bench coordinates, and RFC 2606 example hygiene.

Handoff State & Implementation Playbook for Track 16:
1. Core consensus: Binary Substrate (Virtual, Physical), Functional Triad Role (Target, Instrument, Precondition), Scaffolding handled by TransientLease, standard RFC addressing (uri: Option[String]), PhysicalLocation for civic/bench coordinates, and RFC 2606 example hygiene.
2. Roadmap integration: Track 16 registered in conductor/next-steps.md, Scale Manifesto & Core Tenet 14 added to conductor/product.md, Fixture hygiene added to AGENTS.md.
3. Execution sequence to resume:
   a. Create worktree: git worktree add -b track/artifact-world-state-ontology ../ccrystal-worktrees/artifact-world-state-ontology main
   b. Register worktree lease in crystal: crystal_transient_lease action=lease
   c. Run conductor-new-track to generate spec.md and plan.md for track 16
   d. Follow Red-Green TDD across core (models, codecs) -> cli -> hydration beam.
